title: Hacker Conversations: Corey Thuen and the Evil Bit
description: This content is an interview-style article profiling Corey Thuen, a hacker and CEO of Gravwell, discussing his philosophy on hacking, the concept of the 'evil bit' as an adversarial mindset, and his career path including work in cybersecurity and open source tools development. It does not describe a specific security vulnerability or threat.
